SessionStart.description: SessionStart lifecycle. Context injection (previous session summary, instincts, learned skills, project info) is off via env.ECC_SESSION_START_CONTEXT (#496, AC-025); the entry itself stays wired because session-start.js registers the CLV2 observer session lease unconditionally, ahead of that gate — removing the entry would silently stop the learning-engine observation this change is required to preserve.

UserPromptSubmit.description: Detect optimization-worthy (long, task-shaped) prompts and inject additionalContext suggesting $prompt-conform before execution (task #367). No `matcher` field: UserPromptSubmit does not support matchers per the official Hooks reference and always fires on every prompt. Tunable via PROMPT_CONFORM_SUGGEST_MIN_LENGTH / PROMPT_CONFORM_SUGGEST_TASK_REGEX / PROMPT_CONFORM_SUGGEST_KEYWORD_REGEX env vars; falls back to built-in defaults on invalid overrides. Fail-open: never blocks prompt submission.
Record hook payloads per session for wave-orchestrator so the parent can detect a stopped child without scraping the TUI (#437). Fail-open: no-op without jq or a writable state dir.

PreToolUse.description: Block edits to linter/formatter config files (bypass per session with ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS_EXTRA=pre:config-protection, #281)

Bash safety dispatcher (Theme H, strict profile). The retained sub-hooks are block-no-verify, auto-tmux-dev, and pre:bash:gateguard-fact-force; tmux-reminder, git-push-reminder and commit-quality are disabled via env.ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS (#496, AC-010) because they only ever injected advisory text. Each sub-hook self-gates on ECC_HOOK_PROFILE/ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS. The gateguard keeps its destructive fact-forcing (honouring GATEGUARD_BASH_EXTRA_DESTRUCTIVE, task #12) while GATEGUARD_BASH_ROUTINE_DISABLED=1 switches off only the routine gate on the session's first non-read-only Bash (#496, AC-009).

CLV2 observer (PreToolUse): capture tool_start to observations.jsonl and lazy-start the Haiku observer. observe.sh is invoked directly (not via the ECC observe-runner.js) because the ECC plugin root has no skills/ tree, so the runner cannot locate it; observe.sh resolves its own SKILL_ROOT from $0. async so it never adds per-tool latency.
Record hook payloads per session for wave-orchestrator so the parent can detect a stopped child without scraping the TUI (#437). Fail-open: no-op without jq or a writable state dir.

PostToolUse.description: CLV2 observer (PostToolUse): capture tool_complete to observations.jsonl and signal the observer. Direct observe.sh invocation, async — see pre:observe:continuous-learning.

Record hook payloads per session for wave-orchestrator so the parent can detect a stopped child without scraping the TUI (#437). Fail-open: no-op without jq or a writable state dir. AskUserQuestion が決着したことを tool_use_id のペアリングで判定するため（#448）。PostToolUse は成功時のみ発火するので、通常の tool failure を拾う PostToolUseFailure と対で配線する。なお Esc キャンセルはどちらも発火しない（実機検証で確認）。その遷移だけは send-to-pane.sh --dismiss が画面で閉鎖を確認したうえで決着を書き戻して回復する。

PostToolUseFailure.description: Track failed MCP tool calls, mark unhealthy servers, and attempt reconnect. CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT_NAME=PostToolUseFailure is set explicitly because Claude Code does not export it and mcp-health-check.js would otherwise default to the PreToolUse handler.
